description: This header file defines a proxy server class and related functions for handling socket connections in the Android Cuttlefish project. It declares the ProxyServer class, which manages a server thread and stop file descriptor, and functions for executing and asynchronously handling TCP proxying between socket connections.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: A class that manages a TCP proxy server, running in a separate thread with control over startup and shutdown.

methods.name: ProxyServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy server with a socket and client factory.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Waits for the server thread to finish execution.

methods.name: ~ProxyServer
methods.description: Destructor that handles cleanup of the proxy server.

methods.name: Proxy
methods.description: Function to run a TCP proxy loop, accepting connections and forwarding data indefinitely unless the server is closed.

methods.name: ProxyAsync
methods.description: Creates a ProxyServer instance that runs asynchronously, returning a unique pointer.
